backend/main.mo: Main actor for the ICP backend, managing user profiles, comments, rating images, live rating list, bulk keys, and access keys with admin-gated CRUD operations and role-based authorization via AccessControl and MixinAuthorization mixins.
backend/migration.mo: Defines a migration function that upgrades the actor state from OldActor (with a single globalAccessKey field) to NewActor (with a multi-entry accessKeys map), preserving all other state fields.
feature_evidence.json: A feature evidence report mapping implemented feature IDs and titles to the frontend/backend files they touch, associated component versions, test IDs, and confidence levels.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: A JSON-formatted text file containing one-to-two sentence summaries of each frontend source file, serving as a quick reference for the purpose and key behavior of every component, page, and hook.
frontend/index.css: Base Tailwind CSS entry point that defines OKLCH-based CSS custom properties for the full design token set (colors, radius, chart, sidebar) in both light and dark modes.
frontend/index.html: HTML shell for the React SPA with a pre-React error handler that renders a fallback UI on fatal load errors and a process.env browser shim to prevent ReferenceErrors.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component that wires together QueryClient, ThemeProvider, view-based navigation (user/upload/live/admin), admin PIN unlock flow, prefetching of live list and comments on actor mount, and lazy-loaded page components.
frontend/src/components/AccessDeniedScre: Presentational component that renders a centered card with a shield icon and destructive alert informing non-admin users they lack permission to access the Admin Panel.
Modal dialog component that prompts users to enter and verify an access key, using the `useVerifyAccessKey` mutation hook and toggling password visibility.
frontend/src/components/AdminAccessKeysP: Admin panel for managing access keys, supporting create, edit, delete, copy, and random key generation via dedicated query hooks.
frontend/src/components/AdminChatPanel.t: Placeholder admin panel component for a chat management interface, displaying a 'coming soon' message.
frontend/src/components/AdminCommentsPan: Admin panel for managing comment lists, supporting creation, deletion, locking, bulk text/file upload of comments, and per-comment deletion.
frontend/src/components/AdminDetailsCard: Static card component displaying hardcoded administrator details including name, contact number, progression, and payment time.
frontend/src/components/AdminImagesPanel: Admin panel that fetches and displays a grid of rating screenshot images from the backend actor, with loading skeletons and metadata.
frontend/src/components/AdminMusicManage: Admin card component for selecting, previewing, uploading, and removing background music files (MP3/WAV, max 10MB) with upload progress tracking.
frontend/src/components/AdminPinDialog.t: A modal dialog component that prompts the user to enter a 4-digit admin access code, validating it against a constant and calling success/cancel callbacks accordingly.
frontend/src/components/AdminSettingsPan: Admin settings panel that allows managing the bulk generator access key, exporting all data, clearing localStorage, and includes the AdminMusicManager component.
frontend/src/components/AdminUserImageTa: Admin UI component for bulk uploading and viewing user images, tracking per-file upload status and progress, with download support.
frontend/src/components/AiCommentCounter: Empty file with no content or exports.
frontend/src/components/AiCommentGenerat: Empty file with no content or exports.
frontend/src/components/AiCommentTable.t: Empty file with no content or exports.
frontend/src/components/AnimatedBackgrou: Canvas-based animated background that renders floating teal/cyan particles and geometric shapes with frame-rate throttling and reduced-motion support.
frontend/src/components/BackgroundMusicP: Placeholder component that renders nothing; music functionality is delegated to AdminMusicManager.
frontend/src/components/BulkGeneratorKey: UI card component for viewing and updating the bulk comment generator access key, with show/hide toggle and simulated async update.
frontend/src/components/ChatBox.tsx: Placeholder component that renders null, noted as no longer used in admin-only mode.
frontend/src/components/Css3DCube.tsx: Empty file with no content or exports.
frontend/src/components/ErrorBoundary.ts: React class-based error boundary that catches unhandled errors and displays a fallback UI with reload and retry options.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Simple footer component displaying the current year, app copyright, and a branded link to caffeine.ai.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: App header component with navigation tabs (User, Upload, Live, Admin), a midnight countdown timer, dark/light theme toggle, and admin lock/unlock controls.
frontend/src/components/Interactive3DCub: Renders an interactive, auto-rotating 3D cube using React Three Fiber and Drei's OrbitControls with a purple/pink metallic material.
Wraps children in a React Suspense boundary with a default skeleton placeholder fallback for lazy-loaded components.
frontend/src/components/MidnightCountdow: Displays a countdown timer to midnight using the useMidnightCountdown hook, supporting compact and full display modes.
frontend/src/components/TopDownShooterGa: A canvas-based top-down shooter game with player movement, enemy spawning/AI, bullet collision, and score tracking rendered via requestAnimationFrame.
Provides React Query hooks for CRUD operations (get, create, update, delete) on access keys via the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and caches a backend actor instance using React Query, supporting both authenticated (Internet Identity) and anonymous access, and invalidates dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useAdminLiveListQueri: Provides React Query hooks to fetch, add, and delete live rating list entries via the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useAiCommentQueries.t: Provides React Query hooks to generate AI comments via the backend actor and retrieve cached AI comments, with toast notifications on success/error.
frontend/src/hooks/useDeviceId.ts: React hook that returns a stable, localStorage-persisted device identifier via the getDeviceId utility.
frontend/src/hooks/useDeviceScopedGenera: Re-exports useGetNextCommentForDevice as useDeviceScopedGenerateComment for device-scoped comment generation.
frontend/src/hooks/useDeviceScopedUserCo: Provides hooks to check and retrieve device-scoped comment history stored in localStorage by list ID.
frontend/src/hooks/useInfiniteScroll.ts: Hook that triggers a load-more callback when the user scrolls within a configurable threshold of the bottom of the page, with loading state management.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides a React context and hook for Internet Identity authentication on the ICP platform, managing login/logout state, identity persistence, and AuthClient creation with configurable options.
frontend/src/hooks/useLiveListQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks for CRUD operations on live rating list entries via the backend actor, including cached username existence checks across multiple apps.
frontend/src/hooks/useMidnightCommentLis: A hook that checks every minute and clears local comment list data from localStorage and React Query cache when midnight is reached, tracking the last clear date to avoid duplicate clears.
A hook that calculates and updates a countdown timer to midnight every second, also detecting when midnight resets occur.
frontend/src/hooks/useMusicPlayer.ts: Manages an HTML Audio element for background music playback, handling volume persistence in localStorage, periodic URL polling from the backend, autoplay with muted fallback, and play/pause toggling.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Provides React Query hooks for managing comment lists and per-list statistics entirely via localStorage, supporting create, delete, lock, add/remove comments, and usage tracking operations.
frontend/src/hooks/useTypingEffect.ts: A hook that animates text display character-by-character at a configurable speed and optional start delay, resetting when the input text changes.
frontend/src/index.css: Global stylesheet defining Tailwind CSS base/components/utilities, CSS custom properties for a teal/cyan light and dark color theme, gradient and glow utilities, and animation keyframe classes.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that mounts the React app with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider wrapping the root App component.
frontend/src/pages/account/ProfilePage.t: Displays the authenticated user's profile information (name, email, mobile, UPI details) read from localStorage.
frontend/src/pages/AdminLiveListPanel.ts: Admin panel component for managing live rating list entries and per-app usernames, with add/delete operations backed by API mutations and localStorage respectively.
frontend/src/pages/AdminPanel.tsx: Top-level admin page with a tabbed interface routing to sub-panels for comments, images, chat, live list, access keys, and settings, with prefetching on tab hover.
frontend/src/pages/LiveListChecker.tsx: Page that lets users select apps/events and check whether entered usernames exist in the stored username lists, displaying grouped found/not-found results.
frontend/src/pages/payments/PaymentsPage: Displays a payment history page with status badges (approved, rejected, pending) for transactions. Currently uses an empty mock array; renders an empty-state UI when no payments exist.
frontend/src/pages/UploadSection.tsx: Page with three cards: uploading a single comment, bulk AI comment generation (gated by access key verification), and uploading a rating image to the backend.
frontend/src/pages/UserView.tsx: User-facing page for generating and copying a single comment from a selected list, with per-device comment persistence and an optional embedded top-down shooter game.
frontend/src/pages/wallet/WalletPage.tsx: Renders a wallet page showing a mock balance of 0 with informational cards about how the wallet works. Balance is hardcoded and intended to be replaced with backend data.
frontend/src/utils/adminPinSession.ts: Exports a single constant ADMIN_ACCESS_CODE ('5676') used for admin operations to match backend compatibility.
frontend/src/utils/dataExport.ts: Provides an exportAllData function that fetches comments, app events, and messages from the backend actor and downloads them as both CSV and JSON files with timestamped filenames.
Placeholder module exporting no-op functions for device history storage (load, save, update, clear); not used in the simplified backend.
frontend/src/utils/deviceId.ts: Generates and persists a unique device identifier in localStorage using crypto.randomUUID or a fallback random hex string, with utilities to get and clear the ID.
frontend/src/utils/localStorageCache.ts: Placeholder module with no-op functions for caching app events in localStorage; not used in the simplified backend.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Provides utilities for reading URL parameters from both query strings and hash-based routing, persisting them in sessionStorage, and removing sensitive parameters from the URL hash without reloading.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration extending the default theme with custom OKLCH-based color tokens, teal/cyan/emerald palettes, gradient background images, and keyframe animations for fade and slide effects.
project_state.json: Tracks project state version 3, summarizing a multi-section web app with a green-blue gradient theme, redesigned Upload section, global Access Key system for Bulk Comment Generator, and Admin panel with Access Key CRUD. Lists existing features, architectural notes, and new feature requests.
